newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London advance on U.S. data.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London advance on U.S. data.

text.p: Gains on Wall Street on Friday dragged Hong Kong stocks higher across the board ahead of the weekend, traders said.
Benign U.S. September inflation data and a downward revision to August retail sales more than compensated for higher-than-forecast September sales figures and pushed T-bonds and shares ahead.
London Hong Kong stocks followed suit, the Hang Seng London Reference Index adding 89.70 points to 12,308.10.
"We've just picked up on the U.S. PPI numbers. We're just following the U.S. market as we have been for the last six months," said one trader.
In Hong Kong overnight, shares ended slightly easier as the market consolidated its strong run in the first half of the week.
The Hang Seng finished 24.07 points lower at 12,218.40.
